correctness.rationale: Rebuilt two simplicial stages: at graph-distance ≤1 the 20 triangular cliques triangulate the icosahedral boundary S2, and at ≤2 the only forbidden vertex pairs are the six antipodes, giving the 5-sphere cross-polytope boundary in R6; radius ≥3 is a full simplex. For A(e_i)=v_i, the six antipodal vertex representatives satisfy AA*=2I3. Thus U=im A* and W=ker A are orthogonal invariant summands; direct A5 class characters of the 6D signed-axis action minus geometric 3D character give the other 3D Galois-conjugate module, both centrally inverted. Every icosahedral triangular face lies in a supporting plane disjoint from origin, so P_U x≠0 on K1; radial straight-line homotopy from inclusion to normalized P_U x stays defined and G-equivariant. Character averaging and algebraic conjugation of the INTEGER fixed-space dimension force dim W^H=dim U^H for any subgroup H, not just cyclic ones. Fixed-point spheres and equatorial maps follow, and source/target reduced homology degrees d-1 and 2d-1 differ for d≥1. The proof is analytic, not extrapolation from the numerically enumerated subgroup lattice.
residual_risks: The source verification of 120 automorphisms, 164 subgroups and coordinate equalities uses floating-point tolerances; the unrestricted proof instead uses exact icosahedral symmetry, signed permutation characters and nonvanishing geometry.
The equivariant radial homeomorphism K1→S(U) and the formal group action are established by direct geometric arguments; no formal proof assistant replay.

final_claim: For the icosahedral graph-metric Vietoris–Rips K1→K2 inclusion under full Aut(I)=A5×C2, K1=S(U) and K2=S(U⊕W) equivariantly, with U and W Galois-conjugate real 3D modules and inclusion G-homotopic to the equatorial map; each subgroup fixed map is empty→empty or S^(d−1)→S^(2d−1) and all reduced fixed-point homology maps are zero.
limitations: Full-equivariant homotopy type of the inclusion, not a claim of equivariant nullhomotopy.
